headline: Mercer International Files for Bankruptcy, Stating B.C. Operations Will Continue
summary: Mercer International filed for bankruptcy protection while assuring that its operations in British Columbia, including the Celgar pulp mill in Castlegar, will continue as usual.
why: Mercer International is a global pulp manufacturer with significant forestry and industrial operations, serving as a key player in the international wood products and paper supply chain.

impacts.name: Mercer International
impacts.why: Filing for bankruptcy protection indicates severe financial distress impacting equity holders.
